title: Echo and Machine Anew
author: Ivo Ishikawa
blurb: Ulyana Marchetti, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
